user_photo.description: URL of a photo of the person who replaces the performer on the left of the clip. A clear, front-facing, well-lit photo of one person works best. JPEG, PNG or WebP, under 30 MB.

readme_information.overview:
Hotel Room Studio Dance Overview

Upload your photo and your duo's photo, then feel the rhythm together in a bright orange studio. Dance to the beat, sing the song side by side under the studio mic, and finish with a synced "shhh" moment made to share.

A portrait-led studio dance template creates a predefined performance sequence, with the exposed optional references controlling customization.

Hotel Room Studio Dance is available through each::labs in the eachlabs family. Required fields are user_photo.

user_photo_2: Optional URL of a photo of the person who replaces the performer on the right of the clip. duration: Length of the output video in seconds, 4 to 15.

Use the Hotel Room Studio Dance API when you need this transformation or analysis as a repeatable step in an application or creative pipeline. The sections below distinguish the required material, adjustable controls and checks that matter before delivery.

Technical Specifications

  • Result type: video.
  • Required fields: user_photo.
  • duration: integer; default 15; minimum 4; maximum 15.
  • resolution: string; options 480p, 720p, 1080p; default "480p".
  • user_photo: string.
  • user_photo_2: string or null.

Values must use the types and accepted options listed in the parameter reference. A displayed default does not remove a required-field requirement. Choose a supported output setting for this entry rather than borrowing a preset from a related model.

Key Considerations

Template framing and choreography are not a general scene-design interface; review the finished identities and transitions.

Several pricing tiers apply. Check the full pricing reference for the chosen settings and supplied references rather than assuming one flat charge.

Prepare user_photo before starting. Optional settings include user_photo_2, duration, resolution. Keep these settings aligned with the intended delivery, especially when a later step expects a particular type or format.

Run a representative request before scaling to a larger collection. Judge the result against the source and the brief, and account for all generated outputs or usage-sensitive options when estimating a batch.

Tips and Tricks

Describe one coherent shot before adding complex action. State the subject, movement, camera behavior and setting separately. For reference-guided requests, choose source images with clear subjects and compatible framing.

Things to Be Aware Of

Watch the entire clip rather than reviewing only a thumbnail. Check subject identity, object boundaries, motion continuity, camera changes and the ending; review the audio as well when the entry includes it.

Optional settings are not necessarily interchangeable with those on another entry in the same family. Use the accepted names, types and values shown for this operation.
